items.title: AMD Reports First Quarter 2026 Financial Results
items.snippet: AMD said the press release contains forward-looking non-GAAP gross margin for its financial outlook, based on current expectations as of May 5, 2026, and listed material risks including export regulations, tariffs, competitive markets, cyclical semiconductor demand, supply chain constraints, and customer ordering/shipment uncertainty.

items.title: AMD Reports Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2025 Financial Results
items.snippet: AMD reported full-year 2025 revenue of $34.6 billion and said it expects greater than 35% company-level revenue CAGR, with greater than 60% revenue CAGR for data center and greater than 10% for Embedded and Client and Gaming.

items.title: AMD Reports Second Quarter 2025 Financial Results
items.snippet: AMD said second-quarter 2025 revenue was a record $7.7 billion and noted robust demand across its computing and AI product portfolio, with growth expected from the ramp of Instinct MI350 accelerators and ongoing EPYC and Ryzen share gains.

items.title: AMD Reports Third Quarter 2025 Financial Results
items.snippet: AMD reported Data Center segment revenue of $4.3 billion, up 22% year over year, driven by strong demand for 5th Gen EPYC processors and Instinct MI350 Series GPUs; the release also referenced the OpenAI partnership and planned MI450 deployment in the second half of 2026.
